name: how-it-works
description: Create and maintain a visual HOW_IT_WORKS.md for non-technical product owners from local code and evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a codebase into a clear, visual product explanation.
interface.longDescription: Create or refresh HOW_IT_WORKS.md from local repository evidence. Explain product flows and module responsibilities with useful diagrams. Separate code, test, runtime, and user acceptance evidence.
defaultPrompt: Explain how this project works and create a visual HOW_IT_WORKS.md for a non-technical product owner.
Refresh HOW_IT_WORKS.md to match the current code and evidence. Mark missing runtime or user acceptance evidence.
